title: Parlor Klondike
description: Classic Klondike on green baize — daily deal, Vegas scoring, undo & hints.
detailedDescription: Klondike solitaire as it ought to feel: a quiet card parlor with mahogany trim and linen-finish decks. Classic and draw-three modes, Vegas rules, a seeded daily deal, undo stack, hints, and auto-collect to the foundations.
controls: Tap to select · Tap pile to move · Double-tap auto-play · U undo · H hint
